limitations: Real L4, dimension at least two, small positive skew only; no full-parameter minimizers, complex extension, or independent verification is claimed. Partial bibliographic priority risk from differently named older duality-map inequalities.
scientific_integrity: The t>=4 case is already implied by the motivating source and its balanced optimizer. The new contribution is the sharp t<4 lower law, uniform all-t statement, and rigidity. No independent validation is claimed.
title: Uniform quadratic small-skew law and extremizer rigidity in real \(L_4\)
